items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: We had a little combo down there. Saxophone player that played with me down there. Sunday. Harold Dajon.

ctx.x: Yeah. He just knows what number's on.

Now when I was working down here at the Melody Inn. We had a little combo down there. Saxophone player that played with me down there. Sunday. Harold Dajon. Harold Dajon was on sax. Same piano player was there with me playing. Simon Fraser.
